method: Direct view_image inspection of all four actual rendered PNG contact sheets, followed by nearest-pixel enlargement of four flagged captured frames. No simulation rerun for enlargement. Initial form/source assessment precedes diagnosis through seed IDs.

Eight phase sheets assess coarse visual coherence and framing, not physical gait/contact tolerances.
No new source-counterfactual or care evidence captured in003; those remain separate probes.
